source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ אֶת־רוּחִי֙ עַל־כָּל־בָּשָׂ֔ר וְנִבְּא֖וּ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם זִקְנֵיכֶם֙ חֲלֹמ֣וֹת יַחֲלֹמ֔וּן בַּח֣וּרֵיכֶ֔ם חֶזְיֹנ֖וֹת יִרְאֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be after this, I will pour out my spirit on all flesh, and will prophesy your sons and your daughters; your old men dreams will dream; your young men visions will see.

en.L: And it will be after this [that] I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit on all flesh, \q and they will prophesy, your sons and your daughters; \q as for your old men, they will dream dreams; \q as for your young men, they will see visions.
en.B: And afterward I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit upon all people. \q Your sons and your daughters will prophesy; \q your old men will have dreams, \q and your young men will see visions.
en.R: After that, I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit on all people, \q and your sons and your daughters will speak messages from God. \q Your old men will dream dreams, \q and your young men will see visions.

pt.L: E acontecerá depois disso [que] derramarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito sobre toda carne, \q e profetizarão os filhos e as filhas de vocês; \q os velhos de vocês sonharão sonhos; \q os jovens de vocês verão visões.
pt.B: Depois disso derramarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito sobre toda a humanidade. \q Os filhos e as filhas de vocês profetizarão; \q os idosos de vocês terão sonhos, \q e os jovens de vocês terão visões.
pt.R: Depois disso, vou derramar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito sobre pessoas de todos os lugares, \q e os filhos e as filhas de vocês vão anunciar mensagens de Deus. \q Os velhos de vocês vão sonhar, \q e os jovens de vocês vão ter visões.

fr.L: Et il arrivera après cela [que] je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur toute chair, \q et ils prophétiseront, vos fils et vos filles ; \q vos vieillards, ils songeront des songes ; \q vos jeunes hommes, ils verront des visions.
fr.B: Après cela, je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur toute l’humanité. \q Vos fils et vos filles prophétiseront ; \q vos vieillards auront des rêves, \q et vos jeunes hommes verront des visions.
fr.R: Plus tard, je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur les gens de partout, \q et vos fils et vos filles transmettront des messages de Dieu. \q Vos vieillards feront des rêves, \q et vos jeunes hommes auront des visions.

es.L: Y sucederá después de esto [que] derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sobre toda carne, \q y profetizarán {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos y {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas; \q {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ancianos soñarán sueños; \q {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} jóvenes verán visiones.
es.B: Y después de esto derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sobre toda la humanidad. \q {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} hijos y {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas profetizarán; \q {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ancianos tendrán sueños, \q y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} jóvenes verán visiones.
es.R: Después de eso derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sobre toda la humanidad, \q y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos y {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas darán mensajes de parte de Dios. \q {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} ancianos tendrán sueños, \q y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} jóvenes verán visiones.

sw.L: Na itakuwa baada ya haya [kwamba] nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya kila mwenye mwili, \q nao watatabiri, wana wenu na binti zenu; \q wazee wenu wataota ndoto; \q vijana wenu wataona maono.
sw.B: Na baadaye nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya watu wote. \q Wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri; \q wazee wenu wataota ndoto, \q na vijana wenu wataona maono.
sw.R: Baada ya hayo nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya watu wote, \q na wana wenu na binti zenu watanena ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu. \q Wazee wenu wataota ndoto, \q na vijana wenu wataona maono.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra sau đó, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên mọi xác thịt; \q con trai và con gái các ngươi sẽ nói tiên tri; \q những người già của các ngươi sẽ thấy chiêm bao; \q những thanh niên của các ngươi sẽ thấy khải tượng.
vi.B: Sau đó, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên mọi người. \q Con trai và con gái các ngươi sẽ nói tiên tri; \q người già các ngươi sẽ thấy chiêm bao, \q và thanh niên các ngươi sẽ thấy khải tượng.
vi.R: Sau đó, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên mọi người, \q và con trai, con gái các ngươi sẽ nói sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời. \q Người già các ngươi sẽ thấy chiêm bao, \q và thanh niên các ngươi sẽ thấy khải tượng.

ko.L: 그 뒤에 [이런 일이] 있을 것이다. 내가 내 영을 모든 육체에 부어 주겠다. \q 그러면 너희 아들들과 너희 딸들이 예언할 것이다. \q 너희 늙은이들은 꿈을 꾸고, \q 너희 젊은이들은 환상을 볼 것이다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 내가 내 영을 모든 사람에게 부어 주겠다. \q 너희 아들딸들은 예언하고, \q 너희 노인들은 꿈을 꾸며, \q 너희 젊은이들은 환상을 볼 것이다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 나는 내 영을 모든 사람에게 부어 주겠다. \q 너희 아들과 딸들이 하나님의 말씀을 전할 것이다. \q 너희 노인들은 꿈을 꾸고, \q 너희 젊은이들은 환상을 볼 것이다.

am.L: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ መንፈሴን በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ አፈስሳለሁ፤ \q ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፤ \q ሽማግሌዎቻችሁ ሕልም ያልማሉ፤ \q ወጣቶቻችሁም ራእይ ያያሉ።
am.B: ከዚያም በኋላ መንፈሴን በሰው ሁሉ ላይ አፈስሳለሁ። \q ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፤ \q ሽማግሌዎቻችሁ ሕልም ያልማሉ፤ \q ወጣቶቻችሁም ራእይ ያያሉ።
am.R: ከዚያ በኋላ መንፈሴን በየትም ባሉ ሰዎች ላይ አፈስሳለሁ፤ \q ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ከእግዚአብሔር የተቀበሉትን መልእክት ይናገራሉ። \q ሽማግሌዎቻችሁ ሕልም ያልማሉ፤ \q ወጣቶቻችሁም ራእይ ያያሉ።

hi.L: और इसके बाद ऐसा होगा [कि] मैं अपना आत्मा सब प्राणियों पर उँडेलूँगा, \q और तुम्हारे बेटे और तुम्हारी बेटियाँ भविष्यद्वाणी करेंगे; \q तुम्हारे बूढ़े, वे स्वप्न देखेंगे; \q तुम्हारे जवान, वे दर्शन देखेंगे।
hi.B: इसके बाद मैं अपना आत्मा सब मनुष्यों पर उँडेलूँगा। \q तुम्हारे बेटे और तुम्हारी बेटियाँ भविष्यद्वाणी करेंगे; \q तुम्हारे बूढ़े सपने देखेंगे, \q और तुम्हारे जवान दर्शन देखेंगे।
hi.R: इसके बाद मैं अपना आत्मा हर जगह के लोगों पर उँडेलूँगा, \q और तुम्हारे बेटे और तुम्हारी बेटियाँ मेरी ओर से संदेश सुनाएँगे। \q तुम्हारे बूढ़े सपने देखेंगे, \q और तुम्हारे जवान दर्शन देखेंगे।

ru.B: И после этого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа на всех людей. \q Ваши сыновья и ваши дочери будут пророчествовать, \q ваши старцы будут видеть сны, \q а ваши юноши — видения.
ru.R: После этого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа на всех людей, \q и ваши сыновья и ваши дочери будут говорить людям то, что откроет им Бог. \q Ваши старики будут видеть сны, \q а ваши юноши будут видеть видения.

ja.L: そして、この後、こうなる。わたしはすべての肉の上に、わたしの霊を注ぐ。 \q あなたがたの息子たちと娘たちは預言し、 \q あなたがたの老人たちは夢を見、 \q あなたがたの若者たちは幻を見る。
ja.B: その後、わたしはすべての人に、わたしの霊を注ぐ。 \q あなたがたの息子も娘も預言し、 \q 老人たちは夢を見、 \q 若者たちは幻を見る。
ja.R: その後、わたしは、わたしの霊をあらゆる人に注ぐ。 \q あなたたちの息子も娘も、神から与えられた言葉を語る。 \q 年寄りたちは夢を見、 \q 若い者たちは幻を見る。

decisions.choice: This verse is 3:1 in the Hebrew text, 2:28 in Bibles that follow the Latin and later numbering
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text begins a new chapter here, so that the book has four chapters. Many Bibles continue chapter 2, so their 2:28-32 is 3:1-5 here, and their chapter 3 is chapter 4 here. Open Word Bible follows the numbering of the Hebrew text it translates, and Joel is cited by the Hebrew numbers.

decisions.choice: I will pour out my Spirit: God gives his own Spirit freely, like rain
decisions.reason: The Spirit of God is pictured as water poured out in abundance (Isaiah 32:15; 44:3; Ezekiel 39:29). In the Old Testament the Spirit came on particular people, prophets, judges and kings. Moses had wished that all the LORD's people were prophets and that the LORD would put his Spirit on them (Numbers 11:29). Here that wish becomes a promise.

decisions.choice: all flesh: all people, of every kind
decisions.reason: "Flesh" stands for human beings in their weakness and mortality (Isaiah 40:6). The verses that follow name sons and daughters, old and young, and slaves: the gift is not limited by sex, age or rank. In the first place "your" sons and daughters are Israel, but "all flesh" reaches wider, and Acts 2 applies it so.

decisions.choice: old men and young men, dreams and visions
decisions.reason: The words for the old and the young are masculine, and stand for the old and the young of the people, as the sons and daughters stand for both sexes. Dreams and visions were ways in which God spoke to prophets (Numbers 12:6).

decisions.choice: quoted by Peter at Pentecost (Acts 2:17-21)
decisions.reason: Peter quotes 3:1-5 to explain the coming of the Spirit at Pentecost. He follows the Greek translation and makes some changes: "after this" becomes "in the last days", and he adds "and they will prophesy" in the next verse. The text here is translated from the Hebrew, not brought into line with Acts.

decisions.choice: on all flesh (L); upon all people (B), on all people (R); Spirit with a capital S
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "all flesh"; Balanced and Readable say "all people", as set for the Twelve. God's Spirit is written with a capital S at every level.

decisions.choice: speak messages from God (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what prophesying is, as in Acts 2:17.

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of Acts 2:17 where the Hebrew is the same; depois disso (every level) for Acts' "nos últimos dias"; o meu Espírito (L) for Acts' "do meu Espírito"
decisions.reason: Peter quotes these verses (m5), so each level keeps the Portuguese of Acts 2:17: "derramarei ... sobre toda carne" (L), "sobre toda a humanidade" (B), "sobre pessoas de todos os lugares" (R), "os filhos e as filhas de vocês", "vão anunciar mensagens de Deus" (R). Where Acts follows the Greek, the Hebrew is followed: "depois disso" for "nos últimos dias", with no "diz Deus"; "o meu Espírito" at Literal for the Greek's "do meu Espírito"; and the old men before the young men, the Hebrew order, which Acts reverses.

decisions.choice: de vocês: God speaks to the whole people
decisions.reason: As in Acts 2:17, God speaks to the people as a group, so "de vocês"; "seus" could be read as "their".

decisions.choice: "derramaré mi Espíritu sobre toda carne" (L); "sobre toda la humanidad" (B, R); "darán mensajes de parte de Dios" (R)
decisions.reason: Worded as Spanish Acts 2:17 where the Hebrew says the same thing, so that Peter's quotation can be seen. The Hebrew has no partitive, so it is "mi Espíritu", not Acts' "de mi Espíritu" (L), and "después de esto", not Peter's "en los últimos días".

decisions.choice: Hebrew 3:1-5 is English 2:28-32
decisions.reason: The Spanish follows the Hebrew chapter and verse numbers, as the English does; the meaning footnote gives the other numbering.

decisions.choice: "je répandrai mon Esprit sur toute chair" (L), "sur toute l'humanité" (B), "sur les gens de partout" (R); "prophétiseront" (L, B), "transmettront des messages de Dieu" (R)
decisions.reason: The key words of the published French Acts 2:17-18 at each level, so a reader can see Peter's quotation; but not Acts' partitive "de mon Esprit", which comes from the Greek, not the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "Roho wangu juu ya kila mwenye mwili" (L); "juu ya watu wote" (B, R); "watatabiri", "wataota ndoto", "wataona maono"
decisions.reason: Peter quotes this passage in Acts 2:17-21, so the shared phrases are worded as the Swahili of Acts 2:17 ("kila mwenye mwili", "wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri", "wazee wenu wataota ndoto", "vijana wenu wataona maono"). The Hebrew has "after this" where Acts, following the Greek, has "in the last days". "Roho" is capitalised: God's own Spirit. Readable "watanena ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu" is Acts 2:17 R.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh" at every level
decisions.reason: The Old Testament keeps "Thần Linh" for the Spirit of God, as Isaiah 44:3 and 61:1; Peter's quotation in Acts 2:17 has "Thánh Linh", the New Testament's word for the same Spirit.

decisions.choice: "trên mọi xác thịt" (L); "trên mọi người" (B, R); "nói tiên tri" (L, B), "nói sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: The shared phrases follow the published Vietnamese of Acts 2:17 at each level, so a reader can see Peter's quotation; Peter's "in the last days" comes from his own framing and is not in Joel.

decisions.choice: Shared phrases worded as the Korean Acts 2:17: "내가 내 영을 모든 육체에 부어 주겠다" (L), "모든 사람에게" (B, R); "예언하고" (L, B), "하나님의 말씀을 전하고" (R); "늙은이들" (L), "노인들" (B, R); "젊은이들". "After this" stays "그 뒤에"
decisions.reason: Peter quotes this passage at Pentecost and adds "in the last days" (Greek); the Hebrew says "after this", so Korean does not copy Peter's words there.

decisions.choice: God's Spirit is "영" ("내 영"), with -시- when others speak of him
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "성령" for the New Testament; in the prophets God's Spirit is "영" (Isaiah 44:3; Acts 2:17 also says "내 영").

decisions.choice: the Amharic of Acts 2:17 kept level by level where the Hebrew agrees: "መንፈሴን ... ላይ አፈስሳለሁ", "በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ" (L), "በሰው ሁሉ" (B), "በየትም ባሉ ሰዎች" (R), "ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ትንቢት ይናገራሉ", "ሽማግሌዎቻችሁ ሕልም ያልማሉ", "ወጣቶቻችሁ ራእይ ያያሉ"
decisions.reason: Peter quotes this verse at Pentecost. Where Acts differs from the Hebrew, the Hebrew is followed: "after this" ("ከዚህም በኋላ") for Acts' "in the last days ... says God"; "my spirit" ("መንፈሴን") at Literal, where Acts' Literal has "from my spirit" ("ከመንፈሴ"); and the old men before the young men, the Hebrew order, which Acts reverses.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Joel 3.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: the wording of Acts 2:17 at each level: सब प्राणियों (L), सब मनुष्यों (B), हर जगह के लोगों (R); भविष्यद्वाणी करेंगे (L, B), मेरी ओर से संदेश सुनाएँगे (R)
decisions.reason: Peter quotes these verses at Pentecost (meaning decision m5), so each level keeps the Hindi of Acts 2:17-21 where the Hebrew says the same; "all flesh" therefore takes Acts' words here rather than सब देहधारी.

decisions.choice: इसके बाद; अपना आत्मा; the old men before the young men
alternatives: अंतिम दिनों में ... परमेश्वर कहते हैं (Acts 2:17)
decisions.reason: Acts 2:17 follows the Greek Old Testament and Peter's reading: "in the last days, says God", "from my Spirit", and the young men before the old. Joel's Hebrew says "after this" and "my Spirit" and names the old men first, so the Hindi translates the Hebrew here and keeps Acts' words elsewhere.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans; आत्मा masculine
decisions.reason: As through Joel, the English deity_pronoun spans have nothing to change in Hindi. God's Spirit takes masculine agreement (अपना आत्मा), as in Acts 2:17.

decisions.choice: the wording of Acts 2:17 where the Hebrew agrees; "после этого" for the Hebrew's "after this", and the old men before the young men
decisions.reason: Peter quotes these verses at Pentecost, so each level reuses Acts 2:17-21 in this translation (изолью моего Духа, на всякую плоть at L, будут пророчествовать, видеть сны, видения). Where Acts follows the Greek Old Testament or Peter applies the words ("in the last days", "says God", the young men named first), the Hebrew is translated instead.

decisions.choice: на всякую плоть (L); на всех людей (B, R)
decisions.reason: All flesh means all people of every kind (meaning decision). Literal keeps Acts 2:17's "на всякую плоть"; Balanced and Readable say all people, as the English.

decisions.choice: 3:1-5 is drafted from the Hebrew, with the Acts 2:17-21 Japanese checked and its words kept where the Hebrew agrees: ruchi "わたしの霊" (not "聖霊", by the ISA rule for ruach), kol basar "すべての肉" (L), "すべての人" (B), "あらゆる人" (R); nibbe'u "預言する" (L, B), "神から与えられた言葉を語る" (R).
decisions.reason: Acts quotes the Greek, with "in the last days" and "says God"; Joel's "after this" ("この後 / その後") and order (old men before young men) are kept.

decisions.choice: Old men before young men, as the Hebrew, where Acts 2:17 has young men first.
decisions.reason: Follows the Hebrew order.

source.text: וְגַ֥ם עַל־הָֽעֲבָדִ֖ים וְעַל־הַשְּׁפָח֑וֹת בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔מָּה אֶשְׁפּ֖וֹךְ אֶת־רוּחִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And even on the male slaves and on the female slaves in those days I will pour out my spirit.

en.L: And even on the male slaves and on the female slaves \q in those days \q I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit.
en.B: Even on servants, men and women alike, \q in those days \q I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit.
en.R: Even on servants, both men and women, \q I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit in those days.

pt.L: E até sobre os escravos e sobre as escravas, \q naqueles dias, \q derramarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito.
pt.B: Até sobre os servos e as servas, \q naqueles dias, \q derramarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito.
pt.R: Até sobre os servos e as servas \q vou derramar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito naqueles dias.

fr.L: Et même sur les esclaves hommes et sur les esclaves femmes, \q en ces jours-là, \q je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit.
fr.B: Même sur les serviteurs et sur les servantes, \q en ces jours-là, \q je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit.
fr.R: Même sur les serviteurs, hommes et femmes, \q je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit en ce temps-là.

es.L: Y aun sobre los esclavos y sobre las esclavas \q en aquellos días \q derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu.
es.B: Aun sobre los siervos y las siervas, \q en aquellos días, \q derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu.
es.R: Incluso sobre los siervos, hombres y mujeres, \q derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu en aquellos días.

sw.L: Na hata juu ya watumwa wa kiume na juu ya watumwa wa kike \q katika siku zile \q nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Hata juu ya watumishi, wanaume kwa wanawake, \q katika siku hizo \q nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.R: Hata juu ya watumishi, wanaume na wanawake, \q nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} katika siku hizo.

vi.L: Và ngay cả trên các nam nô lệ và các nữ nô lệ, \q trong những ngày ấy, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ đổ Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Ngay cả trên các đầy tớ, nam cũng như nữ, \q trong những ngày ấy, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ đổ Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Ngay cả trên các đầy tớ, cả nam lẫn nữ, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ đổ Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong những ngày ấy.

ko.L: 남종들과 여종들에게도 \q 그날들에 \q 내가 내 영을 부어 주겠다.
ko.B: 종들에게도, 남자에게나 여자에게나 \q 그날에 \q 내가 내 영을 부어 주겠다.
ko.R: 종들에게도, 남자에게나 여자에게나 \q 그때에 나는 내 영을 부어 주겠다.

am.L: ደግሞም በወንዶች ባሪያዎችና በሴቶች ባሪያዎች ላይ \q በእነዚያ ቀናት \q መንፈሴን አፈስሳለሁ።
am.B: በወንዶችና በሴቶች አገልጋዮች ላይ እንኳ \q በእነዚያ ቀናት \q መንፈሴን አፈስሳለሁ።
am.R: በወንዶችም በሴቶችም አገልጋዮች ላይ እንኳ \q በእነዚያ ቀናት መንፈሴን አፈስሳለሁ።

hi.L: और दासों और दासियों पर भी \q उन दिनों में \q मैं अपना आत्मा उँडेलूँगा।
hi.B: दास-दासियों पर भी, \q उन दिनों में \q मैं अपना आत्मा उँडेलूँगा।
hi.R: दासों पर भी, चाहे वे पुरुष हों या स्त्रियाँ, \q मैं उन दिनों में अपना आत्मा उँडेलूँगा।

ru.L: И даже на рабов и на рабынь \q в те дни \q изолью {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа.
ru.B: Даже на рабов и рабынь \q в те дни \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа.
ru.R: Даже на рабов — и на мужчин, и на женщин — \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа в те дни.

ja.L: また、男の奴隷たちと女の奴隷たちの上にさえ、 \q その日々に、 \q わたしはわたしの霊を注ぐ。
ja.B: しもべたちにも、男にも女にも、 \q その日には、 \q わたしの霊を注ぐ。
ja.R: しもべたちにも、男にも女にも、 \q その日には、わたしの霊を注ぐ。

decisions.choice: the male and female slaves: those of the lowest rank
decisions.reason: The words name men and women who were owned by others, with no standing of their own. The Spirit does not pass them by. In Acts 2:18 the Greek has "my" slaves, so that they are God's servants too.

decisions.choice: even: the gift reaches further than anyone would expect
decisions.reason: The word stresses what follows: even those whom others overlook.

decisions.choice: servants, men and women (B, R); male slaves and female slaves (L)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets, Literal says "slave" and Balanced and Readable "servant"; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that these were people who were owned.

decisions.choice: os escravos e as escravas (L); os servos e as servas (B, R), with no "meus" and no "e eles profetizarão"
decisions.reason: The words are those of Acts 2:18 in Portuguese ("escravos ... escravas" at Literal, "servos ... servas" at Balanced and Readable), but the Hebrew has no "my" before them and does not add "and they will prophesy", which come from the Greek that Acts quotes (m1); Portuguese follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "esclavos y esclavas" (L); "siervos y siervas" (B); "siervos, hombres y mujeres" (R)
decisions.reason: As Spanish Acts 2:18 at each level. Joel says "the" slaves, where Acts has "my" slaves, so no deity_pronoun span stands here.

decisions.choice: "watumwa wa kiume ... wa kike" (L); "watumishi, wanaume kwa wanawake" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Acts 2:18 at each level and the English levels.

decisions.choice: "các nam nô lệ và các nữ nô lệ" (L); "các đầy tớ, nam cũng như nữ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: These are slaves in ordinary life, not "servants of the LORD", so Literal keeps "nô lệ" with the English; Balanced and Readable say "đầy tớ" as Acts 2:18 B and R do.

decisions.choice: the Amharic of Acts 2:18: "ባሪያዎች" (L), "አገልጋዮች" (B, R), "በእነዚያ ቀናት ... መንፈሴን አፈስሳለሁ"; without Acts' "my" and "and they will prophesy"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the male slaves and the female slaves", not "my slaves", and does not add "and they will prophesy" ("ትንቢትም ይናገራሉ"), which Acts 2:18 has; the Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: दासों और दासियों (L); दास-दासियों (B); दासों ... चाहे वे पुरुष हों या स्त्रियाँ (R), as Acts 2:18
decisions.reason: The words of Acts 2:18 at each level, with दास at every level as the style guide keeps for slaves (meaning decision m1). Acts follows the Greek in saying "my" slaves and adding "and they will prophesy"; the Hebrew has neither, so the Hindi leaves them out.

decisions.choice: на рабов и на рабынь, without "my" and without "and they will prophesy"
alternatives: на моих рабов и на моих рабынь ... и будут пророчествовать (Acts 2:18)
decisions.reason: Acts 2:18 follows the Greek Old Testament in saying "my" slaves and in adding "and they will prophesy". The Hebrew has neither, so they are left out; "рабы и рабыни" keeps Acts' word at every level, as the meaning decision is those of the lowest rank.

decisions.choice: 'avadim / shefachot "男の奴隷たちと女の奴隷たち" (L), "しもべたちにも、男にも女にも" (B, R), as the style table and Acts 2:18; no "わたしの" before them, as the Hebrew (Acts adds "my").
decisions.reason: Translated from the Hebrew; the Acts form is kept where it agrees.

source.text: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ מֽוֹפְתִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ דָּ֣ם וָאֵ֔שׁ וְתִֽימֲר֖וֹת עָשָֽׁן׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will put wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.

en.L: And I will put wonders \q in the sky and on the earth, \q blood and fire \q and columns of smoke.
en.B: I will show wonders \q in the sky and on the earth: \q blood and fire \q and columns of smoke.
en.R: I will do amazing things \q in the sky and on the earth. \q There will be blood and fire \q and great clouds of smoke.

pt.L: E darei prodígios \q no céu e na terra, \q sangue e fogo \q e colunas de fumaça.
pt.B: Farei prodígios \q no céu e na terra: \q sangue e fogo \q e colunas de fumaça.
pt.R: Vou fazer coisas espantosas \q no céu e na terra. \q Vai haver sangue e fogo \q e grandes nuvens de fumaça.

fr.L: Et je mettrai des prodiges \q dans le ciel et sur la terre, \q du sang et du feu \q et des colonnes de fumée.
fr.B: Je ferai paraître des prodiges \q dans le ciel et sur la terre : \q du sang et du feu \q et des colonnes de fumée.
fr.R: Je ferai des choses extraordinaires \q dans le ciel et sur la terre. \q Il y aura du sang et du feu \q et d’épais nuages de fumée.

es.L: Y pondré prodigios \q en el cielo y en la tierra: \q sangre y fuego \q y columnas de humo.
es.B: Mostraré prodigios \q en el cielo y en la tierra: \q sangre y fuego \q y columnas de humo.
es.R: Haré cosas asombrosas \q en el cielo y en la tierra. \q Habrá sangre y fuego \q y grandes nubes de humo.

sw.L: Nami nitaweka maajabu \q katika anga na katika nchi, \q damu na moto \q na nguzo za moshi.
sw.B: Nitaonyesha maajabu \q angani na duniani: \q damu na moto \q na nguzo za moshi.
sw.R: Nitafanya mambo ya kushangaza \q angani na duniani. \q Kutakuwa na damu na moto \q na mawingu makubwa ya moshi.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt những điều kỳ diệu \q trên bầu trời và trên đất, \q máu và lửa \q và những cột khói.
vi.B: Ta sẽ tỏ ra những điều kỳ diệu \q trên bầu trời và dưới đất: \q máu và lửa \q và những cột khói.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm những việc lạ lùng \q trên bầu trời và dưới đất. \q Sẽ có máu và lửa \q và những đám khói dày đặc.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 기이한 일들을 두겠다. \q 하늘과 땅에 [두겠다]. \q 피와 불과 \q 연기 기둥들이다.
ko.B: 내가 놀라운 일들을 보이겠다. \q 하늘과 땅에서 \q 피와 불과 \q 치솟는 연기 기둥을 보이겠다.
ko.R: 나는 놀라운 일들을 하겠다. \q 하늘과 땅에서 하겠다. \q 피와 불이 있고, \q 거대한 연기 구름이 피어오를 것이다.

am.L: ድንቆችንም እሰጣለሁ \q በሰማይና በምድር ላይ፤ \q ደምንና እሳትን \q የጢስንም ዓምዶች።
am.B: ድንቅ ነገሮችን አሳያለሁ \q በሰማይና በምድር ላይ፤ \q ደምን፣ እሳትንና \q የጢስ ዓምዶችን።
am.R: አስደናቂ ነገሮችን አደርጋለሁ \q በሰማይና በምድር ላይ። \q ደምና እሳት \q ታላቅ የጢስ ደመናም ይታያል።

hi.L: और मैं अद्भुत काम दूँगा \q आकाश में और पृथ्वी पर, \q लहू और आग \q और धुएँ के खंभे।
hi.B: मैं अद्भुत काम दिखाऊँगा \q आकाश में और धरती पर: \q लहू और आग \q और धुएँ के खंभे।
hi.R: मैं अचंभे की बातें करूँगा \q आकाश में और धरती पर। \q लहू और आग होगी \q और धुएँ के बड़े-बड़े बादल।

ru.L: И дам чудеса \q на небе и на земле, \q кровь и огонь \q и столбы дыма.
ru.B: Я совершу чудеса \q на небе и на земле: \q кровь и огонь \q и столбы дыма.
ru.R: Я сделаю удивительные дела \q на небе и на земле. \q Будут кровь и огонь \q и огромные клубы дыма.

ja.L: そして、わたしは不思議な業を与える、 \q 空に、また地に。 \q 血と火と、 \q 煙の柱を。
ja.B: わたしは不思議な業を示す。 \q 空に、また地に。 \q 血と火と、 \q 煙の柱を。
ja.R: わたしは驚くようなことを行う。 \q 空でも、地上でも。 \q 血と火が現れ、 \q 大きな煙の雲が立ちのぼる。

decisions.choice: wonders: signs of God's power
decisions.reason: The word is used for the wonders the LORD did in Egypt (Exodus 7:3; Deuteronomy 6:22) and for signs that point to what he is about to do.

decisions.choice: blood, fire and columns of smoke: war and the LORD's coming
decisions.reason: Blood and fire are the marks of war and slaughter. Columns of smoke rise from a burning city (Judges 20:38-40), and smoke and fire marked the LORD's coming down on Sinai (Exodus 19:18).

decisions.choice: Acts 2:19 adds "above", "signs" and "below"
decisions.reason: Peter's quotation in Acts 2:19 has "wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below". The Hebrew has "wonders in the heavens and on the earth".

decisions.choice: the sky (all levels)
decisions.reason: The word means both sky and heaven; every level says "sky", set against the earth. Readable says "amazing things" for "wonders" and "great clouds" for "columns".

decisions.choice: prodígios, no céu e na terra (as Acts 2:19, without "em cima", "sinais" and "embaixo")
decisions.reason: The words follow Acts 2:19 in Portuguese ("darei prodígios" L, "farei prodígios" B, "coisas espantosas" R), without the "above", "signs" and "below" that Acts adds (m3). The Hebrew "columns of smoke" is "colunas de fumaça" (L, B) and "grandes nuvens de fumaça" (R), where Acts says "vapor de fumaça".

decisions.choice: "prodigios" (L, B); "cosas asombrosas" (R)
decisions.reason: As Spanish Acts 2:19; Joel has no "señales", "arriba" or "abajo", which Peter adds.

decisions.choice: "ድንቆችን" (L), "ድንቅ ነገሮችን" (B), "አስደናቂ ነገሮችን" (R) as Acts 2:19; "የጢስ ዓምዶች" (columns of smoke)
alternatives: Acts' "በላይ በሰማይ ... በታችም በምድር ላይ ምልክቶችን"
decisions.reason: Acts 2:19 adds "above", "signs" and "below" and has "vapor of smoke"; the Hebrew has wonders in the heavens and on the earth, and columns of smoke, and is followed. The wonders keep Acts' words.

decisions.choice: अद्भुत काम (L, B), अचंभे की बातें (R), as Acts 2:19; धुएँ के खंभे
alternatives: ऊपर आकाश में ... नीचे धरती पर चिह्न
decisions.reason: Acts 2:19 keeps the words for wonders, sky, blood and fire used here; it adds "above", "signs" and "below" and has "vapor of smoke" (meaning decision m3). The Hindi translates the Hebrew, which has none of these and speaks of columns of smoke.

decisions.choice: чудеса на небе и на земле; столбы дыма
alternatives: чудеса на небе вверху и знамения на земле внизу ... курение дыма (Acts 2:19)
decisions.reason: The verbs and "чудеса" / "удивительные дела" are Acts 2:19's; Acts also has "above", "signs" and "below", which the Hebrew lacks (meaning decision), and the Hebrew's columns of smoke are kept.

decisions.choice: mofetim "不思議な業" (L, B; Acts 2:19), "驚くようなこと" (R); timrot "煙の柱" (L, B), "大きな煙の雲" (R). Acts' "上 / 下" and "しるし" are not added.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only wonders in the sky and on earth (m3).

source.text: הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ יֵהָפֵ֣ךְ לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהַיָּרֵ֖חַ לְדָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: The sun will be turned into darkness and the moon into blood, before [the] coming of [the] day of Yahweh, the great and the fearful.

en.L: The sun will be changed into darkness, \q and the moon into blood, \q before the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes, \q the great and fearful [day].
en.B: The sun will turn dark \q and the moon blood red \q before the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes, \q that great and terrible day.
en.R: The sun will become dark, \q and the moon will become red like blood, \q before the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes. \q It will be a great and terrible day.

pt.L: O sol se transformará em trevas, \q e a lua em sangue, \q antes que venha o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q o grande e temível [dia].
pt.B: O sol se tornará escuro, \q e a lua, vermelha como sangue, \q antes que chegue o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q aquele grande e terrível dia.
pt.R: O sol vai ficar escuro, \q e a lua vai ficar vermelha como sangue, \q antes que chegue o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. \q Será um dia grande e terrível.

fr.L: Le soleil sera changé en ténèbres, \q et la lune en sang, \q avant que vienne le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q le grand et redoutable [jour].
fr.B: Le soleil s’obscurcira \q et la lune deviendra rouge sang \q avant que vienne le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q ce jour grand et redoutable.
fr.R: Le soleil deviendra sombre, \q et la lune deviendra rouge comme du sang, \q avant que le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} arrive. \q Ce sera un jour grand et terrible.

es.L: El sol se convertirá en tinieblas, \q y la luna en sangre, \q antes que venga el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q el grande y temible.
es.B: El sol se oscurecerá \q y la luna se volverá roja como la sangre \q antes que venga el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q ese día grande y terrible.
es.R: El sol se pondrá oscuro, \q y la luna se pondrá roja como la sangre, \q antes que venga el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Será un día grande y terrible.

sw.L: Jua litageuzwa kuwa giza, \q na mwezi kuwa damu, \q kabla ya kuja siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ile [siku] kuu na ya kutisha.
sw.B: Jua litatiwa giza \q na mwezi utakuwa mwekundu kama damu \q kabla siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijaja, \q siku ile kuu na ya kutisha.
sw.R: Jua litakuwa giza, \q na mwezi utakuwa mwekundu kama damu, \q kabla siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijaja. \q Itakuwa siku kuu na ya kutisha.

vi.L: Mặt trời sẽ biến thành tối tăm, \q và mặt trăng thành máu, \q trước khi ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến, \q [ngày] lớn lao và đáng sợ.
vi.B: Mặt trời sẽ tối sầm \q và mặt trăng đỏ như máu \q trước khi ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến, \q là ngày lớn lao và đáng sợ.
vi.R: Mặt trời sẽ tối lại, \q và mặt trăng sẽ đỏ như máu, \q trước khi ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến. \q Đó sẽ là một ngày lớn lao và đáng sợ.

ko.L: 해가 어둠으로, \q 달이 피로 바뀔 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날, \q 크고 두려운 [날이] 오기 전에.
ko.B: 해가 어두워지고 \q 달이 핏빛으로 변할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날, \q 그 크고 두려운 날이 오기 전에.
ko.R: 해가 어두워지고, \q 달이 피처럼 붉어질 것이다. \q 그런 다음에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 올 것이다. \q 그날은 크고 무서운 날이다.

am.L: ፀሐይ ወደ ጨለማ፣ \q ጨረቃም ወደ ደም ትለወጣለች፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ከመምጣቱ በፊት፣ \q ታላቁና የሚያስፈራው [ቀን]።
am.B: ፀሐይ ትጨልማለች፤ \q ጨረቃም እንደ ደም ትሆናለች፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ከመምጣቱ በፊት፣ \q ያ ታላቅና አስፈሪ ቀን።
am.R: ፀሐይ ትጨልማለች፤ \q ጨረቃም እንደ ደም ትቀላለች። \q ከዚያም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ይመጣል። \q ያ ቀን ታላቅና አስፈሪ ይሆናል።

hi.L: सूर्य अंधकार में \q और चाँद लहू में बदल जाएगा, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आए, \q वह महान और भयावना [दिन]।
hi.B: सूर्य अँधेरा हो जाएगा \q और चाँद लहू-सा, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आए, \q वह महान और भयानक दिन।
hi.R: सूरज अँधेरा हो जाएगा, \q और चाँद लहू की तरह लाल हो जाएगा, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आए। \q वह महान और भयानक दिन होगा।

ru.L: Солнце превратится во тьму, \q и луна — в кровь, \q прежде чем придёт день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q великий и страшный.
ru.B: Солнце станет тёмным, \q а луна кровавой, \q прежде чем наступит день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q великий и страшный день.
ru.R: Солнце потемнеет, \q а луна станет красной, как кровь, \q прежде чем придёт день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. \q Это будет великий и страшный день.

ja.L: 太陽は闇に変えられ、 \q 月は血に[変えられる]。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が来る前に。 \q 大いなる、恐ろしい[日が]。
ja.B: 太陽は暗くなり、 \q 月は血の色に変わる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が来る前に。 \q あの大いなる恐ろしい日が。
ja.R: 太陽は暗くなり、 \q 月は血のように赤くなる。 \q そのあとで、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が来る。 \q それは、大いなる恐ろしい日だ。

decisions.choice: the moon into blood: the moon turned dark red
decisions.reason: When the moon is darkened, as in an eclipse, it can look red. The darkened sun and the blood-red moon are signs of the day (2:10; 4:15).

decisions.choice: the great and fearful day of the LORD
decisions.reason: The day is described in the same words in 2:11 and Malachi 3:23. See the note on the day of the LORD at 1:15.

decisions.choice: Acts 2:20 reads "glorious" for "fearful"
decisions.reason: Peter's quotation follows the Greek translation, which has "glorious". The Hebrew word means "to be feared".

decisions.choice: fearful (L); terrible (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:11, Literal says "fearful" and Balanced and Readable "terrible". Readable says what "the moon into blood" looks like.

decisions.choice: o dia do SENHOR; temível (L), terrível (B, R), where Acts 2:20 has "o dia do Senhor ... glorioso"
decisions.reason: The sun and moon keep the Portuguese of Acts 2:20. The day is "o dia do SENHOR", with the divine name, and "temível" / "terrível" as in 2:11, where Acts follows the Greek "glorious" (m3) and says "Senhor".

decisions.choice: "grande y temible" (L); "grande y terrible" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "fearful"; Spanish Acts 2:20 has "grande y glorioso" / "esplendoroso" / "maravilloso" from the Greek, so the two passages differ here on purpose. The first half of the verse is worded as Acts 2:20.

decisions.choice: "grand et redoutable" (L, B); "grand et terrible" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "fearful"; Acts 2:20 follows the Greek, which reads "glorious" ("éclatant" in the French of Acts), so the French keeps Acts' "Le soleil sera changé en ténèbres et la lune en sang" at Literal but not its last word.

decisions.choice: "kuu na ya kutisha"
decisions.reason: From the Hebrew ("fearful"); Acts 2:20 has "tukufu" because it follows the Greek, so the two passages differ here on purpose.

decisions.choice: "ngày của CHÚA ... lớn lao và đáng sợ"
alternatives: "ngày lớn và vinh hiển của Chúa" (Acts 2:20)
decisions.reason: The great and fearful day keeps the terms-sheet wording. Acts 2:20 has "Chúa" and "vinh hiển" because it follows the Greek; Joel is translated from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "크고 두려운 날" (L, B); "크고 무서운 날" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "fearful"; Acts 2:20 has "영광스러운" because it quotes the Greek. Korean keeps the Hebrew, as the term sheet asks.

decisions.choice: the Amharic of Acts 2:20 kept: "ፀሐይ ወደ ጨለማ፣ ጨረቃም ወደ ደም ትለወጣለች" (L), "ፀሐይ ትጨልማለች፤ ጨረቃም እንደ ደም ትሆናለች" (B), "... ትቀላለች" (R), "... ከመምጣቱ በፊት"; "fearful" ("የሚያስፈራው", "አስፈሪ") for Acts' "glorious"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew noraʾ is "fearful", where the Greek of Acts reads "glorious"; the Hebrew is followed, with the word of 2:11. Acts names the day "of the Lord" ("የጌታ ቀን"); here it is the day of YHWH, under the divine_name setting.

decisions.choice: the sun and moon in the words of Acts 2:20; {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन; भयावना (L), भयानक (B, R)
decisions.reason: Acts 2:20 reads "glorious" where the Hebrew has "fearful" (meaning decision m3), and "the Lord" for the divine name. The Hindi keeps Acts' words for the sun and moon and translates the Hebrew: the day of the LORD in the note's form, and "fearful" as in 2:11.

decisions.choice: великий и страшный
decisions.reason: The rest of the verse keeps Acts 2:20's words at each level; the Hebrew's "fearful" (nora) is kept where Acts follows the Greek Old Testament's "glorious".

decisions.choice: hannora' "恐ろしい" every level, as 2:11 and the Hebrew, not Acts 2:20 "輝かしい / すばらしい" (the Greek reading); yom YHWH "主の日".
decisions.reason: Translated from the Hebrew (m3).

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֛א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה יִמָּלֵ֑ט כִּ֠י בְּהַר־צִיּ֨וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה פְלֵיטָ֗ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וּבַ֨שְּׂרִידִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה קֹרֵֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be [that] everyone who calls on [the] name of Yahweh will escape; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be escape, as Yahweh has said, and among the survivors whom Yahweh calls.

en.L: And it will be [that] everyone who calls on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will escape; \q for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be [those who] escape, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has said, \q even among the survivors \q whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} calls.
en.B: Then all who call on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be saved. \q On Mount Zion and in Jerusalem some will escape, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has said, \q among the survivors \q whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} calls.
en.R: Then everyone who calls to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help will be saved. \q Some people on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem will escape, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has promised. \q They will be among those who survive, \q the ones {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} calls.

pt.L: E acontecerá [que] todo aquele que invocar o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} escapará; \q porque no monte Sião e em Jerusalém haverá [os que] escapam, conforme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse, \q sim, entre os sobreviventes \q que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} chama.
pt.B: Então todo aquele que invocar o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} será salvo. \q No monte Sião e em Jerusalém alguns escaparão, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse, \q entre os sobreviventes \q que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} chama.
pt.R: Então todo aquele que clamar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pedindo ajuda será salvo. \q Algumas pessoas no monte Sião e em Jerusalém vão escapar, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} prometeu. \q Elas vão estar entre os que sobrevivem, \q aqueles que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} chama.

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] quiconque invoquera le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} échappera ; \q car sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem il y aura des rescapés, comme l’a dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et parmi les survivants \q que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appelle.
fr.B: Alors tous ceux qui invoqueront le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} seront sauvés. \q Sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem, il y aura des rescapés, comme l’a dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q parmi les survivants \q que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appelle.
fr.R: Alors tous ceux qui appelleront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à l’aide seront sauvés. \q Sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem, des gens échapperont, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a promis. \q Ils feront partie de ceux qui survivront, \q ceux que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appelle.

es.L: Y sucederá [que] todo el que invoque el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} escapará; \q porque en el monte Sion y en Jerusalén habrá [quienes] escapen, como ha dicho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q aun entre los sobrevivientes \q a quienes {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llama.
es.B: Entonces todo el que invoque el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} será salvo. \q En el monte Sion y en Jerusalén algunos escaparán, como lo ha dicho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q entre los sobrevivientes \q a quienes {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llama.
es.R: Entonces todo el que clame {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda será salvo. \q Algunos en el monte Sion y en Jerusalén escaparán, como lo ha prometido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Estarán entre los que sobrevivan, \q los que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llama.

sw.L: Na itakuwa [kwamba] kila atakayeliitia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataokoka; \q kwa maana katika mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu kutakuwa na [watakaookoka], kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema, \q hata miongoni mwa waliosalia \q ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawaita.
sw.B: Ndipo kila atakayeliitia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataokolewa. \q Katika mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu wengine wataokoka, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema, \q miongoni mwa waliosalia \q ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawaita.
sw.R: Ndipo kila mtu atakayemlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amsaidie ataokolewa. \q Baadhi ya watu katika mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu wataokoka, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoahidi. \q Watakuwa miongoni mwa wale watakaobaki hai, \q wale ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawaita.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra [rằng] mọi người kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ thoát nạn; \q vì trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ có [những người] thoát nạn, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán, \q và ở giữa những người sống sót \q mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} kêu gọi.
vi.B: Bấy giờ ai kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đều sẽ được cứu. \q Trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ có người thoát nạn, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán, \q ở giữa những người sống sót \q mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} kêu gọi.
vi.R: Bấy giờ ai kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ đều sẽ được cứu. \q Một số người trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ thoát nạn, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa. \q Họ sẽ ở trong số những người sống sót, \q là những người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} kêu gọi.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르는 사람은 누구나 피할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로, 시온산과 예루살렘에 피하는 [사람들이] 있을 것이기 때문이다. \q 살아남은 자들 가운데, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 부르시는 자들 가운데 [있을 것이다].
ko.B: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르는 사람은 누구나 구원을 받을 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 시온산과 예루살렘에서 피할 사람들이 있을 것이다. \q 그들은 살아남은 사람들, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 부르시는 사람들이다.
ko.R: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 부르짖는 사람은 누구나 구원을 받을 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로, 시온산과 예루살렘에서 몇몇 사람이 피할 것이다. \q 그들은 살아남은 사람들 가운데 있을 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 부르시는 사람들이다.

am.L: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ያመልጣል፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ተናገረ በጽዮን ተራራና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚያመልጡ ይኖራሉና፤ \q ከተረፉትም መካከል \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚጠራቸው [ይኖራሉ]።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ጠርቶ የሚለምን ሁሉ ይድናል። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ተናገረው በጽዮን ተራራና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚያመልጡ ይኖራሉ፤ \q ከተረፉትም መካከል \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚጠራቸው ይገኛሉ።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ እርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚጣራ ሁሉ ይድናል። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቃል እንደ ገባው በጽዮን ተራራና በኢየሩሳሌም አንዳንድ ሰዎች ያመልጣሉ። \q እነርሱም ከጥፋቱ ከተረፉት መካከል ይሆናሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚጠራቸው ናቸው።

hi.L: और ऐसा होगा [कि] जो कोई {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का नाम पुकारेगा, वह बच निकलेगा; \q क्योंकि सिय्योन पर्वत पर और यरूशलेम में [वे लोग] होंगे जो बच निकलें, जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है, \q बचे हुओं में भी \q जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} बुलाते हैं।
hi.B: तब जो कोई {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का नाम पुकारेगा, वह उद्धार पाएगा। \q सिय्योन पर्वत पर और यरूशलेम में कुछ लोग बच निकलेंगे, जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है, \q उन बचे हुओं में \q जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} बुलाते हैं।
hi.R: तब जो कोई मदद के लिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को पुकारेगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उसे बचाएँगे। \q सिय्योन पर्वत पर और यरूशलेम में कुछ लोग बच जाएँगे, जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने वचन दिया है। \q वे उन लोगों में होंगे जो बच निकलेंगे, \q जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} बुलाते हैं।

ru.L: И будет [так]: всякий, кто призовёт имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, спасётся; \q ведь на горе Сион и в Иерусалиме будут спасшиеся, как сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, \q и среди уцелевших, \q которых призывает {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: И тогда всякий, кто призовёт имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, будет спасён. \q На горе Сион и в Иерусалиме будут спасшиеся, как сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, \q среди уцелевших, \q которых призывает {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Тогда каждый, кто позовёт {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на помощь, будет спасён. \q Некоторые люди на горе Сион и в Иерусалиме спасутся, как обещал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Они будут среди уцелевших, \q тех, кого призывает {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を呼び求める者は皆、逃れる、ということになる。 \q シオンの山とエルサレムに、逃れる者があるからだ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたとおりに。 \q 生き残った者たちの中に、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が呼ばれる[者たちの中に]。
ja.B: そのとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を呼び求める者は皆、救われる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたとおり、シオンの山とエルサレムには、逃れる者がいる。 \q 生き残った者たちの中に、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が呼ばれる者たちがいる。
ja.R: そのとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に助けを求めて呼ぶ人は、だれでも救われる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が約束されたとおり、シオンの山とエルサレムでは、逃れる人々がいる。 \q その人たちは、生き残る者たちの中にいる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が呼ばれる人々だ。

decisions.choice: will escape: will be rescued, saved from the disaster
decisions.reason: The verb means to slip away, escape with one's life, and so to be rescued. It is the same root as the word "escape" (those who escape) in the next line and in 2:3, where nothing escaped the army. The Greek translation, which Peter and Paul quote, has "will be saved".

decisions.choice: call on the name of the LORD: pray to him, turn to him for rescue
decisions.reason: To call on the LORD's name is to appeal to him and rely on him (Genesis 4:26; Psalm 116:4, 13). The verse is not about saying the name but about turning to the LORD.

decisions.choice: quoted in Acts 2:21 and Romans 10:13
decisions.reason: Peter ends his quotation at Pentecost with the first line (Acts 2:21), and his closing words, "as many as the Lord our God will call" (Acts 2:39), echo the end of this verse. Paul quotes the first line in Romans 10:13 and applies "the Lord" to Jesus (Romans 10:9-13). In the Hebrew, the name called on is the divine name, YHWH.

decisions.choice: as the LORD has said: there will be those who escape on Mount Zion
decisions.reason: Obadiah 17 has almost the same words: "on Mount Zion there will be those who escape". Joel may be quoting that promise, or another word of the LORD not recorded elsewhere.

decisions.choice: the survivors whom the LORD calls: those who call on the LORD are the ones he calls
decisions.reason: The verse begins with people calling on the LORD and ends with the LORD calling them. The survivors are those he summons and claims as his own.

decisions.choice: will escape (L); will be saved (B, R)
decisions.reason: As set for the Twelve, Literal says "will escape", the image of the verb, and Balanced and Readable say "will be saved", its sense here (m1). Readable says "calls to the LORD for help" for "calls on the name of the LORD" (m2), as in Acts 2:21.

decisions.choice: todo aquele que invocar o nome do SENHOR escapará (L) / será salvo (B); todo aquele que clamar ao SENHOR pedindo ajuda será salvo (R)
decisions.reason: The first line keeps the Portuguese of Acts 2:21 and Romans 10:13 (m3): "todo aquele que invocar o nome do ... será salvo" (B), and Romans' Readable "todo aquele que clamar ao ... pedindo ajuda será salvo" (R). Two things follow the Hebrew: the divine name ("do SENHOR", with the setting), where the New Testament has "Senhor" from the Greek; and Literal "escapará", the image of the verb (m1), which the next line repeats with "escapam".

decisions.choice: no monte Sião e em Jerusalém haverá [os que] escapam (L); alguns escaparão (B); vão escapar (R)
decisions.reason: Obadiah 17 has almost the same words (m4); its Portuguese should use "no monte Sião haverá os que escapam" (L) and "escapar" at Balanced and Readable, so the two promises read alike.

decisions.choice: "escapará" (L); "será salvo" (B, R); "invoque el nombre" (L, B); "clame ... pidiendo ayuda" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets: B and R are worded as Spanish Romans 10:13 and Acts 2:21 ("todo el que invoque el nombre del Señor será salvo"; R "todo el que clame al Señor pidiendo ayuda será salvo"), with the divine name where Joel has it.

decisions.choice: "quiconque invoquera le nom du SEIGNEUR échappera" (L); "tous ceux qui invoqueront le nom du SEIGNEUR seront sauvés" (B); "tous ceux qui appelleront le SEIGNEUR à l'aide seront sauvés" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the published French Romans 10:13 at each level, so the quotation can be recognized; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "escape" (the English word_sense decision), where Romans has "be saved" from the Greek.

decisions.choice: "ataokoka" (L); "ataokolewa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "escape"; Balanced and Readable say "be saved", as Acts 2:21 and Romans 10:13 ("kila atakayeliitia jina la Bwana ataokolewa"), which quote this line. Readable uses the Romans 10:13 R wording "atakayemlilia ... amsaidie".

decisions.choice: "mọi người kêu cầu danh CHÚA sẽ thoát nạn" (L); "ai kêu cầu danh CHÚA đều sẽ được cứu" (B); "ai kêu cầu CHÚA giúp đỡ đều sẽ được cứu" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable take the wording of Romans 10:13 B and R, with CHÚA for the divine name where the New Testament has "Chúa"; Literal keeps "thoát nạn" for yimmalet, the same verb as "escape" later in the verse.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르는 사람은 누구나 피할 것이다" (L); "…구원을 받을 것이다" (B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 부르짖는 사람은 누구나 구원을 받을 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Acts 2:21 and Romans 10:13 at each level; the default "주의 이름" reads as Romans 10:13 L. Literal keeps "escape" for the Hebrew verb, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the first line as Acts 2:21 and Romans 10:13: "እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ... ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ" (L), "በዚያን ጊዜ ... ስም ጠርቶ የሚለምን ሁሉ ይድናል" (B, Acts), "እርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ ... የሚጣራ ሁሉ ይድናል" (R, Romans); Literal "ያመልጣል" (will escape)
decisions.reason: Where Acts and Romans have "the Lord" ("ጌታ"), the Hebrew has YHWH, under the divine_name setting. Literal follows the Hebrew verb "escape", as the English Literal does and as the next line repeats it ("የሚያመልጡ"); Balanced and Readable keep the New Testament's "will be saved" ("ይድናል"), which says the same rescue.

decisions.choice: जो कोई ... का नाम पुकारेगा, वह बच निकलेगा (L); वह उद्धार पाएगा (B); जो कोई मदद के लिए ... को पुकारेगा, ... उसे बचाएँगे (R)
decisions.reason: Acts 2:21 and Romans 10:13 quote this line (meaning decision m3); Balanced and Readable keep their Hindi words, with the divine name where the Hebrew has it. Literal keeps the image of the verb, "escape" (m1), as the English Literal does, and so differs from Acts there.

decisions.choice: सिय्योन पर्वत
decisions.reason: Mount Zion as Isaiah 37:32, which has the same promise of those who escape from Mount Zion.

decisions.choice: всякий, кто призовёт имя ГОСПОДА, спасётся (L) / будет спасён (B); каждый, кто позовёт ... на помощь, будет спасён (R)
decisions.reason: Acts 2:21 and Romans 10:13 quote this line; Balanced keeps their words with the divine name, and Readable their "позовёт на помощь". Literal says "спасётся" for the Hebrew's "will escape" (word_sense decision), close to the quoted "будет спасён".

decisions.choice: qara' beshem YHWH "主の名を呼び求める" (L, B), "主に助けを求めて呼ぶ" (R), as Acts 2:21; yimmalet "逃れる" (L), "救われる" (B, R), as the English; peletah "逃れる者", seridim "生き残った者たち" (ISA key words); har Tsiyyon "シオンの山".
decisions.reason: Acts 2:21 and Romans 10:13 quote the first line (m3); the Japanese keeps their wording where the Hebrew agrees.
